events.repository_binding: sha256 digest of the repository UUID
events.subject_binding: sha256 digest of repository UUID, aggregate class, and aggregate identifier
events.payload_policy: deny all source payload fields; expose only the envelope allowlist

cursor.expiry: a cursor before the earliest retained sequence is rejected

work_semantics.running: current reserved, launch-uncertain, or running jobs
work_semantics.queued: current new, repair-ready, recovery-ready, or decomposition-ready jobs
work_semantics.blocked: current internal or external blocked jobs
work_semantics.recovered: cumulative recovery-ready transitions followed by a later reservation of the same job
work_semantics.completed: current completed, decomposed, or cancelled jobs

redaction.rule: unknown fields are omitted, never passed through

observer_isolation.database_transaction: bounded read snapshot copied before output
observer_isolation.output: performed only after transaction and connection close
observer_isolation.writer_blocking: observers never acquire writer authority or hold a transaction while writing output

compatibility.changes: additive fields within a version or a new versioned schema
compatibility.unknown_event_types: preserved as transition names without payload exposure
